reader.requirement: A WRITE, successful or not, must leave the file position indicator unchanged, so a later sequential READ continues from where the previous READ left it (on a 1985 sequential file only a failed WRITE can meet an established indicator, since WRITE needs the output or extend mode).

reader.notes: Sequential and relative WRITEs, failed and successful, leave the read position where the last READ put it. A sequential file open I-O refuses WRITE with '48' at 85, as the 1985 GR1 and status 48 say.
